title: Configure Core Skill Activity Invocation Profiles

story.so_that: I can run agentic workflow Activities with the capabilities and safeguards appropriate to each task, with 100% of automated resolution cases and representative configured Story Analysis invocations using the expected settings without permission-related artifact failures
story.as_a: Software Engineer and AI Process Designer
story.i_want: to configure default and per-skill Devin models and tool permissions for each Skill Activity invocation

journey.before: Configures one global Devin model and permission mode, operates Story Analysis workflows, reviews Activity logs, and diagnoses subprocess or sentinel failures.
journey.during: Defines version-controlled defaults and canonical-skill overrides, starts a workflow, and observes each Activity resolve and validate its effective invocation profile from SkillActivityInput.skill_name.
journey.after: Confirms every tested resolution case and representative Story Analysis invocation used the expected model and least-privilege permission mode, including explicit accept-edits overrides for unattended artifact-producing skills.

capability_breakdown.core_action: Deliver the first vertical slice for validated default and per-skill Devin model and permission-mode resolution, command construction, backward-compatible loading, safe logging, tests, and documentation while preserving generic Harness and sentinel contracts.
inputs: Default model and permission_mode values, with auto as the secure default permission mode
Optional partial model and permission_mode override keyed by canonical SkillActivityInput.skill_name
Legacy flat model and permission_mode values, mapped to the new defaults
Supported permission modes: auto, accept-edits, dangerous, and bypass
outputs: One immutable effective model and permission mode resolved for the requested skill
Devin CLI subprocess arguments containing the effective --model and --permission-mode values
Pre-launch validation error naming the affected skill and invalid known setting
Activity log containing skill name, effective model, and effective permission mode without credentials or secrets
Backward-compatible interpretation of the legacy flat configuration
Automated tests and documentation for the first-slice behavior
100% pass rate for resolution tests and representative configured Story Analysis invocations
state_changes: The colocated Devin Harness configuration gains defaults and skills mappings
Legacy flat values continue to load as defaults
Each invocation receives an effective profile selected from structured skill metadata
Artifact-producing skills use explicit accept-edits overrides when unattended repository writes are required
No UI, database, skill-output, or sentinel-contract changes occur
Referenced Devin profiles and runtime retry snapshot transport remain deferred follow-up work

api: DevinHarness receives or resolves the canonical skill name without adding Devin CLI fields to the generic Harness protocol
SkillActivityInput.skill_name remains the structured configuration lookup key
external_services: Host-installed Devin CLI invoked as a subprocess
Cadence executes Skill Activities, while retry snapshot implementation is deferred

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The first slice uses the existing colocated src/orchestrator/devin_harness.config.json file with defaults and skills objects.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the repository configuration is opened When its top-level structure is inspected Then it contains a defaults object and a skills object keyed by canonical skill name
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Review invocation settings in version control

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Defaults apply to any canonical skill with no explicit override.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given defaults specify model SWE-1.7 and permission_mode auto and a skill has no override When its profile is resolved Then the effective model is SWE-1.7 and permission mode is auto
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Apply default settings to unconfigured skills

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Overrides are keyed by canonical skill name, including extract-story-intent, analyze-story, grade-story-analysis, and repair-story-analysis.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given each listed canonical skill has a distinct override When each profile is resolved from SkillActivityInput.skill_name Then each skill receives only its matching override
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Override settings for a named skill

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Profiles independently select the Devin model and a supported permission mode.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a resolved profile selects model M and supported permission mode P When DevinHarness constructs the subprocess command Then --model is followed by M and --permission-mode is followed by P as separate arguments
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Select model and permissions for an invocation

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A partial skill override replaces only specified fields and inherits all unspecified fields from defaults.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given defaults specify model SWE-1.7 and permission_mode auto and analyze-story overrides only permission_mode with accept-edits When analyze-story is resolved Then its model is SWE-1.7 and permission mode is accept-edits
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Customize one skill while inheriting defaults

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The default permission mode is auto and unrestricted modes are used only through explicit configuration.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given permission_mode is omitted from defaults When the default profile is created Then permission mode is auto and neither dangerous nor bypass is selected

acceptance_criteria.criterion: An unattended artifact-producing skill must explicitly resolve to accept-edits or another explicitly selected mode that permits its required writes.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given analyze-story has an explicit accept-edits override When it creates its analysis and sentinel files non-interactively Then both writes complete without an approval prompt

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A restricted skill is never automatically promoted to a broader permission mode.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a skill resolves to auto When it attempts a write requiring confirmation Then the invocation remains auto and reports the harness or missing-artifact failure without retrying under accept-edits, dangerous, or bypass

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Invalid known settings fail before the Devin subprocess starts and identify the affected skill and setting.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given analyze-story sets permission_mode to unsupported-mode When configuration is validated Then the subprocess runner is not called and the error identifies analyze-story and permission_mode

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Explicit null, empty, or wrong-typed known values are invalid rather than treated as inheritance.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a skill override explicitly sets model to an empty string When configuration is validated Then the subprocess runner is not called and the error identifies that skill and model

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unknown top-level and profile keys are ignored without changing known-field resolution.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given valid defaults include an unknown future key and a skill override includes another unknown key When the profile is resolved Then known model and permission_mode values resolve normally and the unknown keys do not reach the Devin command

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Configuration selection uses SkillActivityInput.skill_name and never natural-language prompt parsing.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given SkillActivityInput.skill_name is analyze-story and its prompt mentions repair-story-analysis When configuration is resolved Then the analyze-story profile is selected

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The generic Harness contract and existing skill output and sentinel contracts remain unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a fake alternate Harness implements run(prompt, cwd) and an existing skill writes its current sentinel When run_skill executes Then the alternate Harness requires no Devin fields and the sentinel is read through its existing verify_params key

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Legacy flat model and permission_mode values map to the new defaults without changing effective behavior.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the existing flat configuration specifies model SWE-1.7 and permission_mode auto When it is loaded Then the effective defaults are model SWE-1.7 and permission mode auto and no migration error occurs

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Activity logs record the canonical skill name, effective model, and effective permission mode without credentials, prompt contents, or configuration-file contents.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given analyze-story resolves to model SWE-1.7 and permission mode accept-edits When the Activity logs its invocation Then those three identifiers are present and credential values, prompt text, and configuration contents are absent

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All resolution, validation, inheritance, legacy compatibility, command construction, alternate-Harness, permission, and logging tests pass.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the first-slice automated test suite When it runs Then 100% of the specified configuration behavior tests pass

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Representative unattended invocations of the four Story Analysis skills use expected profiles and produce their existing artifacts.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given valid profiles for extract-story-intent, analyze-story, grade-story-analysis, and repair-story-analysis When each representative invocation runs Then 100% use the expected model and permission mode and complete without a permission-related missing-artifact failure
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Run configured Story Analysis skills successfully

acceptance_criteria.criterion: First-slice documentation defines configuration shape, precedence, supported modes, legacy mapping, security implications, and local examples.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a new operator reads only the first-slice documentation When they configure defaults and an accept-edits override for an artifact-producing skill Then the documented example resolves to the expected profile

edge_cases.gherkin: Given devin_harness.config.json does not exist When a profile is resolved Then model SWE-1.7 and permission mode auto are used
edge_cases.jtbd: Start safely without a configuration file

edge_cases.gherkin: Given devin_harness.config.json is not valid JSON When it is loaded Then no Devin subprocess starts and the configuration path is reported
Given defaults or skills is not an object When configuration is validated Then no subprocess starts and the invalid container is reported

edge_cases.criterion: Empty overrides map and previously unseen canonical skill
edge_cases.gherkin: Given skills is empty and a new canonical skill is invoked When its profile resolves Then it receives the defaults without a missing-override error

edge_cases.criterion: Concurrent invocations use immutable effective profiles
edge_cases.gherkin: Given two skills resolve different overrides concurrently When commands are constructed Then each command contains only its own effective model and permission mode

edge_cases.criterion: Interrupted invocation leaves a stale sentinel
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a previous attempt left a sentinel When run_skill begins a new invocation Then it removes the stale sentinel and accepts only a sentinel created by the current invocation

edge_cases.criterion: Worker cannot read the configuration file
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the worker lacks read permission for devin_harness.config.json When configuration is loaded Then no subprocess starts and a sanitized configuration-read error is reported

edge_cases.criterion: Default auto mode cannot authorize a required unattended write
edge_cases.gherkin: Given an artifact-producing skill has no accept-edits override and resolves to auto When it attempts to write Then permissions are not broadened and the Activity reports failure rather than success
edge_cases.jtbd: Detect a missing edit permission override

edge_cases.gherkin: Given the host Devin CLI is unauthenticated When an Activity invokes it Then the harness reports the authentication failure without logging credentials

edge_cases.criterion: Devin subprocess exits nonzero or cannot be started
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the configured Devin process exits nonzero or executable startup fails When the Activity invokes it Then the Activity reports failure and does not report a successful artifact
Given a skill resolves to accept-edits but the repository filesystem rejects a write When the skill runs Then the Activity fails through the harness or missing-sentinel path without reporting success

Should backward-compatible flat configuration support have a future deprecation date?
